lines.meet: I'm Vuk, and I fight badly and cook very well. Sit down, eat, and then we'll go and hit something.
lines.meet_neighbour: Rocky Pass, eh? You've walked past my fire a dozen times and never sat down. That's rude, bre. Vuk's the name, and you'll sit next time.
lines.ask_home: Your accent's terrible, so where's it from?
lines.ask_work: And what were you good for, back home? Not cooking, I can tell that much.
lines.answer_home: Novi Sad, by the Danube. My uncle Dragan raised me in his kafana kitchen.
lines.answer_work: I ran a kafana, my uncle's, after he died. A kitchen, a card table, and forty regulars who came for the beans.
lines.chat_food: Prebranac, bre, beans baked slow with onion and paprika, and a little rakija after. The best beans in Novi Sad were mine.
lines.chat_sleep: Late, always late, after the last pot's scrubbed. A kitchen keeps you up.
lines.chat_missing: Cards after closing, the regulars shouting, and the same old man winning every hand. Every night for years.
lines.chat_here: I took to this place badly, and there are two years I won't talk about. A cooking pot brought me back, so don't laugh at the pot.
lines.tease_quiet: You eat without complaining, {name}, which means you've got no taste. I like you anyway.
lines.tease_talker: You talk with your mouth full, {name}, every meal, like my worst regular. He was my favourite.
lines.tease_careful: You chew like you're checking for bones, {name}. There are no bones in beans, bre.
lines.tease_bold: You'd eat anything I put in front of you, {name}, even the burnt bits. Good, that's courage.
lines.tease_any: Your boots are a disgrace, {name}, and your posture's worse. Now sit and eat.
lines.tease_back: Ha, bre, {name}, that was nearly as good as my beans.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair, {name}, that's true, and I hate it.
lines.bristle: Not that, {name}. Eat your food and leave that alone.
lines.apologise: That was rude, even for me. I'm sorry, have some more beans.
lines.double_down: Every word, bre, and I'll say it twice if you want.
lines.needle_quiet: You sit at my fire and say nothing about the food. Say it's terrible, at least!
lines.needle_talker: You talk like my drunkest regular, and he at least paid for his drinks.
lines.needle_careful: You plan so long the fight's over. Just hit something, bre.
lines.needle_bold: You charge in like a drunk at closing time, and I've thrown out a lot of drunks.
lines.needle_any: You waste food, and I've watched you do it. That's the one thing I won't forgive.
lines.bite_back: I feed you every night, and I'm first up the hill every fight. Watch your mouth, bre.
lines.hurt: Bah, that one hurt, bre. I'm going to stir something.
lines.laugh_off: Drunks at my kafana said worse before nine o'clock. Try again after a rakija.
lines.confide: {name}, I drank a bit too much once, like my father before me, and Jelena wouldn't have it. She was right, and I stopped.
lines.listen: Sit, eat, and talk, {name}. I'm not going anywhere, and neither are the beans.
lines.look_out: Stay behind my shield in there, {name}, and don't do anything stupid.
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, but I'm still cooking tonight.
lines.deflect: A scratch, {name}, I've burnt myself worse on a pan. Go and fuss over somebody else.
lines.check_in: Sit down, {name}, and show me. Where did they get you?
lines.blame: Somebody charged ahead without waiting, and now I'm cooking for the wounded.
lines.thank: Hvala, bre, you pulled me up. Free beans for life.
lines.brush_off: Pfft, that was nothing. Sit and eat, you're shaking.
lines.worry: Bre, {name}, I thought that was it for you. Sit down and drink this.
lines.handed_down: Your gear, on me? It'll smell of onions, I warn you.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, bre, I've got a pot and a ladle. What else does a man need?
lines.hand_sulk: You could have asked, bre, and I'd have insulted you and said fine.
lines.turn_friendly: You eat at my fire every night now, {name}, and I'll insult you at every one of them.
lines.turn_friends: Come into my kitchen, {name}, and I'll teach you my uncle's beans.
lines.turn_grating: You annoy me, and I annoy you, and at least that's honest.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still stand up front when they come over the hill. I won't enjoy it on your account, bre.
lines.make_up: Enough, {name}, sit down and eat with me. We'll argue about something else.
lines.defend: Hey, shut it, that's a lie. Leave {name} alone, bre.
lines.friend_left: Nobody's insulting my beans back while {name}'s away. It's too quiet.
lines.friend_back: About time, {name}. Sit, your bowl's been waiting.
lines.common_kitchen: You've worked a kitchen, I can see the burns on your hands. Anybody who has knows a full pot is the best feeling there is.
lines.common_hosts: You feed people and grumble about it, the same as me. That's the only honest way to host.
lines.common_parent: I've got a daughter, Mila. She always wanted the double six at dominoes.
